column8: ERROR (one sentence): the sheet said Oolong had 'the best form in the race (Cl2 3rd off 87 on this ground, flying home)' and I picked against the best form line for a STORY — the species law (the unexposed 3yo's floor) and the winning-mark law — while the race's own history (his paste: seven of eight winners were the favourite or second favourite; three of the last four the favourite at 5/2 or shorter) and the market's direction (Oolong 9/4 into 5/4, Proposal 9/4 out to 4/1) both said the best form horse was the horse; and the master's correction on the record: 'he won it last year at the same weight' — checked: her whole career (11 runs) holds NO previous Thirsk win; the 2025 winner on his own table is Dash Of Azure; what IS true is that she had won at Haydock off 82 and run 3rd of 19 at York on this ground off 87, the best form line in the race, and was top weight in form
column9: CALIBRATION: (1) THE DAY'S ONE FAULT IN ITS FIFTH COAT: the read named the best-form horse as the danger and the verdict took the story; Haydock 1:55 I took the exposed form over the tell; here I took the unexposed story over the best form — so the tie-break is NOT 'exposed v unexposed' at all, it is THE BEST FORM LINE AT THE HIGHEST LEVEL (First Law's yard/rider tell = class; Pride Of Arras's G2 = class; Almeraq's G1 = class; Oolong's Cl2 3rd off 87 on the ground = the best form) — 'best horse wins' is literal: the horse with the best proven form at the highest class, and the market's direction confirms it. (2) 'What would make me wrong' named the ground on Proposal; the ground did not beat her — the better horse did; the sheet's mechanism was wrong and the sheet's danger was right. (3) THE PAST WINNERS (his paste): favourites 5 of 8, the second favourite 2 more — a race the market's first two win; Proposal was the 2/1 favourite at 07:38 and the 4/1 second favourite at the off — the drift was the crowd's verdict and the box's board (law 4g) would have seen it. (4) RECORD: the duty's divergence from the engine settles LOST; the engine's own opinion in this race (Proposal conviction 4, Oolong 2) was the same mistake mechanically — the family count (winning mark, +1lb, in-form yard) outranked the single best form line, the ledger's DOWN TO TWO entry in the flesh.
